pages.text: Define a custom projectile's motion, hit processors, appearance and lifecycle actions. Used by Custom Projectile, not directly as an action.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: Add motion maintenance, hits and triggered actions. Reserve a bounded number of callbacks.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: Add motion, appearance and event structures once, not again on every flight tick.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).

pages.title: What to Attach
pages.text: $(li)motion$(br)Motion / Optional; one node at most$(br2)$(li)tick$(br)Action / Optional; one node at most

pages.title: What to Attach
pages.text: $(li)hit$(br)Effect / Add up to 64 nodes$(br2)$(li)renderer$(br)Projectile renderer / Optional; one node at most

pages.title: What to Attach
pages.text: $(li)land$(br)Action / Optional; one node at most$(br2)$(li)expire$(br)Action / Optional; one node at most
